entries.title: Rollback to vulnerable version
entries.description: Downgrade attack reinstalls firmware with a known flaw.
entries.attack_vector: Attacker presents an older, validly signed package or manifest so the TCU installs a version with known vulnerabilities.
entries.damage_scenario: Known vulnerability is re-exposed and exploited.
entries.rationale: Older signed images are often obtainable; installation succeeds if no version counter is enforced.

entries.title: Pivot from compromised TCU to Powertrain CAN
entries.description: A compromised TCU application forwards malicious frames to Powertrain CAN.
entries.attack_vector: Attacker with code execution on the TCU abuses gateway routing to reach safety-relevant buses.
entries.damage_scenario: Attack extends from the connected ECU to powertrain functions.
entries.rationale: Needs a prior TCU compromise and gateway knowledge.
